body.heading: Future you is a real person
paragraphs: It is easy to treat your future self like a stranger: they can deal with the messy room, the unstarted revision, the empty savings jar. But that stranger is you, arriving tomorrow morning whether you prepared for them or not.

Try the reverse. Picture tomorrow-you waking up to one thing already done — the bag packed, the first paragraph written, the form filled in. Small kindnesses to your future self compound surprisingly fast.

body.heading: Ask one question
paragraphs: When you are deciding whether to bother, ask: “What would make tomorrow easier?” Then do the smallest version of that thing. Lay out the clothes. Charge the device. Write the first line tonight so tomorrow starts mid-flow.
And when a past version of you has left you a mess, skip the blame. Clear one corner of it and move on — that is how the kindness loop keeps turning.

takeaway: Do one small thing today that tomorrow-you will be grateful for.
